messages:
samir: Heads-up — onboarding polaris-chat-1 on staging failing low-level chat turn assembly. generation looks fine but multi-turn context gets reset. suspect tokenizer special token mismatch between tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json. Anyone seen this? :eyes:
maria: Yep, saw the same on porter. Fast tokenizer had specials only in tokenizer_config.json while tokenizer.json (the fast dump) didn't include them, so HF->Redwood conversion dropped them. Logs show "Warning: unknown special token '<|system|>'" and then chat template logic falls back to raw prompt.
kyle: Can you paste the two files? Quick compare usually shows renamed fields like `additional_special_tokens` vs `added_tokens`, or missing `bos_token`/`eos_token`.
samir: Pasted snippets here:
``
# tokenizer_config.json
{"unk_token": "<unk>", "bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>", "pad_token": "<pad>"}
# tokenizer.json (fast)
{"vocab": {...}, "special_tokens_map": {"cls_token":"[CLS]"}, ...}
```
Note: tokenizer.json had no `bos_token` entry so our converter fell back to defaults.
maria: Exact — converter uses fast tokenizer blob when present. If fast file lacks explicit mapping for chat tokens like `<|system|>` they get tokenized as subwords and our chat-template matching fails.
ci-bot: deploy-checker: model-pol-01 conversion job completed with warnings (job id 7821). See https://ci.internal/jobs/7821 
kyle: Quick fix options: 1) copy explicit special token keys into tokenizer.json before convert; 2) run `python scripts/hf_to_redwood.py --model polaris-chat-1 --force-tokenizer-config` (script will synthesize missing entries); 3) convert using slow tokenizer: `transformers.PreTrainedTokenizer.from_pretrained(..., use_fast=False)` and dump tokenizer_config.json.
maria: Also watch merges/vocab alignment for BPE models. Missing merges can change tokenization of bracketed tokens — our chat tokens are bracketed. Quick test: `tokenizer.encode("<|system|>hello")` should return a single token for the system token to be recognized by the template heuristic.
samir: I'll try patching tokenizer.json in staging and re-run conversion now. If that fixes it I'll open a PR to make the converter synthesize special tokens from `added_tokens`/`special_tokens_map` when explicit keys are missing.
kyle: Sounds good. Assigning to @samir and tagging RDW-2319 in backlog. :thumbsup:
maria: FYI I added a small unit test in the eval harness to catch this fallthrough (checks that all chat roles map to single-token markers). Will include test in the PR.
samir: Thanks all — will report back with job id and diff. If we find more models with inconsistent metadata we should run a catalog scan and auto-flag before onboarding. :facepalm:
